GROUP PROJECT- PRESENTATION (Final Group Project Presentation Slides: Due Nov 30th & Presentation & Product Demonstration Dec 1st & 3rd)

  • Due Nov 30 by 11:59pm
  • Points 20
  • Submitting a text entry box or a file upload
  • Available until Dec 1 at 10:30am

Submit Final Group Presentation Slides (see the template below)- only one submission for each group

Presentation- Marking Scheme- Group.docx

Final Presentation Slides

  1. Topic Heading and Team members
  2. Project Introduction
  3. Your Approach (Lifecycle Model you used)
  4. Context Diagram
  5. Major Requirements (e.g. use case diagram & descriptions)
    • two main functional requirements
    • one main non-functional requirement (security, ethical, usability, etc)
  6. Architecture Design
  7. Class Diagram (at least three classes, attributes, methods, relations, constraints)
  8. Major Operation (one sequence diagram)
  9. Unit test cases & results
  10. GUI / UX (navigation diagram, screen shots(2))
  11. Database design (ERD, Relational Table Design)
  12. Implementation Plan
  13. Major Acceptance Test Cases
  14. two test cases & test results
  15. Possible Future Enhancement

You also need to demonstrate your final product.

 

Product Demonstration Rubrics

Creativity- Novelty (10 points)

Functionality (20 points)

UX (10 points)

Overall (10 points)

After code submitted- Code Review (later)

Implementation- Modularization (10 points)

Maintainability (10 points)

Test report (10 points)

User Manual (10 points)

Git hub (5 points)

All (5 points)
